low_high_quality: scaled from central by the participant ratio. Cost per participant is take-up invariant: locked directly on the authorised basis at rung 12 (§0.3) and measured on the MOO-48 ladder at all six rungs (§0.1). Applying it to the authorised basis away from rung 12 is an inference from those two facts, not a measurement.
